progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gk4 and dwells most on Bb in Takht-e Taghdis. The line peaks at Ck5 (531.6 Hz) at 0:13.0. It closes on Ds4, not the tonic (Ds4 → Gk4 → Gk4 → Ds4 → Ds4 → Ds4).
